什么是气候“临界点”（tipping point），举两个例子。

What is a climate 'tipping point'? Give two examples.

临界点指系统被推过阈值后发生不可逆或自持的突变。例如格陵兰冰盖不可逆消融、亚马孙雨林向稀树草原转变——一旦越过，即便停止排放也难恢复。
A tipping point is a threshold beyond which a system shifts irreversibly or self-amplifies. Examples: irreversible Greenland ice-sheet loss and Amazon rainforest-to-savanna transition—once crossed, recovery is hard even if emissions stop.

为什么 1.5–2°C 升温可能同时触发多个气候“临界点”？

Why might 1.5–2°C warming trigger several climate tipping points at once?

冰盖、AMOC、雨林、珊瑚等系统各有阈值且彼此关联（如暖化削弱 AMOC 又改变雨林降水），升温接近区间时多个子系统可能相继越过临界点，引发级联且难逆转的变化。
Ice sheets, AMOC, rainforests and reefs each have thresholds and are interlinked (warming weakens AMOC and shifts rainforest rains); near this range several may cross points in sequence, causing cascading, hard-to-reverse change.

为什么科学家担心“级联”临界点？

Why are scientists concerned about 'cascading' tipping points?

一个区域触发可能通过大气环流、洋流或碳释放影响另一区域，形成连锁反应。例如南极冰损失削弱洋流，进而改变热带降雨，放大全局风险。
One region tipping can affect another via atmospheric circulation, ocean currents or carbon release, creating chains. E.g., Antarctic ice loss weakens currents, altering tropical rainfall and amplifying global risk.
